connect.title: Save videos to your shelf
connect.lead: Downloading needs no account. To save videos to your shelf on tapeshelf, connect it once.

found.title: On this page
found.empty: No video here yet. Start playing it: the extension notices what the page loads.
found.noPage: Open a page with a video.
found.youtube: This version of the extension does not download from YouTube.

limit.reached: That is all for today: {{limit}} videos a day through the extension on Free. Pro has no limit.
limit.verify: Confirm your email on tapeshelf to save videos.

errors.disconnected: The extension is no longer connected. Connect it again.
errors.network: No connection. Try again: it goes on where it stopped.
errors.source: The site did not give the video (error {{status}}). Open the page again and try from there.
errors.drm: The video is protected (DRM) and cannot be saved.
errors.live: A live stream can be saved once it has ended.
errors.tooBig: The video is bigger than the room on your shelf or the file size limit.
errors.empty: The site gave an empty file.
errors.noVideo: There is no video in this stream.
errors.disk: Not enough room on the disk for this video.
errors.format: The site gave files the extension cannot put together into a video.
errors.deliver: The browser did not save the file ({{reason}}). Try again.
errors.captureNothing: This page's player gave the extension no video, so it can't be recorded this way.
errors.pageGone: The tab with this video was closed or went to another page. Open the video again and download it anew.

options.title: Extension settings
options.serverHint: tapeshelf.com, or the address of your own tapeshelf server. Another server means connecting again.
options.serverInvalid: That is not a server address.
options.formHint: Title, description, category and who sees it. Off: a video is saved at once, with the choices below.
options.sourceHint: Shown on the video's page, to you alone.
options.shortcutHint: The browser changes them in its shortcut settings.
options.privacy: The extension sends nothing anywhere: downloads go to your computer, and only the videos you save go to your server.
options.qualityHint: Picked for every video; another can be chosen in the list. The menu and the shortcut download in this one.
options.shelfHint: Offer the shelf after a download
options.shelfHintHint: One line under the newest download in the popup.
options.audioLanguageHint: When a video has its sound in several languages.
options.skipAdsHint: The ads a stream marks, and short stretches from other servers in it.
options.blockedHint: One per line: example.com covers its subdomains too.
options.siteNamesHint: Its template instead of the one above, from the same fields.
options.captureHint: The extension copies what the player loads to the disk ahead of time; it is wiped when the tab closes.
options.pageButtonsHint: Beside the site's own buttons on VK, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, Bilibili and other sites the extension knows.

update.howTo: Unpack it over the extension's folder, then press ⟳ on tapeshelf in chrome://extensions.
update.howToFirefox: Open the downloaded file in Firefox to install the new version over the old one.

hint.text: Downloaded. Build your own video shelf: phone, link, search —

history.title: History
history.private: Only in this browser: the extension sends it nowhere.
history.empty: Videos you download will be listed here.
history.off: The history is off. Downloads are listed in the popup until the browser closes.

capture.nothing: Nothing to download here — you can record it
capture.fromStart: From the start of the video
capture.waiting: Waiting for the player — start the video if it isn't playing
